fields.Brand Positioning: Everhome Suites is Choice's midscale extended-stay brand—purpose-built for longer stays with in-suite kitchens, modern design, and operational support from Choice's extended-stay experts.
fields.Brand Customer Promise: A convenient, modern home away from home with fully equipped kitchens, social outdoor living, Homebase marketplace, and amenities that help guests maintain routines on stays averaging about 15 nights.
fields.Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: Midscale extended stay with kitchens, separate sleep/work/eat spaces, fitness, outdoor living, and 24/7 self-service Homebase market (materials).

Owners: First new core midscale brand in nearly a decade (2020); prototypical builds; 70+ extended-stay experts; energy-efficient design features.

Communities: Guests supporting local retail, dining, and events on longer stays.
fields.Brand Pillars:
Midscale extended stay — kitchens, longer LOS, residential functionality.

Purpose-built prototype — developed with extended-stay developers and operators.

Homebase experience — tech-enabled market, laundry, and flexible lobby/work spaces.

Efficient design — energy-efficient appliances, windows, and lighting; EV charging where applicable.
fields.Brand History: Introduced in 2020 as the first new core midscale brand in nearly a decade; first hotel opened in Corona, CA, with 65+ properties under development (Choice materials).
fields.Guest Psychographics Description: Value-conscious guests staying ~15 nights on average ($98K HHI in brand materials)—temporary work assignments, travel nurses, relocations, renovations, and bleisure—who need kitchens and routine-friendly suites.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators:
Fully equipped in-suite kitchens with dishware and appliances.

Social outdoor living with fire pits, grills, and optional pool.

Energy-efficient building standards and modular furniture.

Backed by Choice extended-stay team with 70+ dedicated experts.
fields.Sustainability Positioning: Prototype emphasizes energy-efficient appliances, windows, and lighting; aligned with Choice Hotels' Room to be Green® and ESG programs.
